comment: Furiah's Visuals: the Crescent Bow's own clip (its swings, draw and the shared inspects are the bow set's). Every clip here is original to this mod.

crescent_bow_moonrise.comment: Moonrise: the bow taken out low before you and laid on its back, side-on, so its whole crescent shows with the horns up like a new moon's, tilted; then lifted slowly as a moon rises, levelling as it climbs until its horns cradle the middle of the view, its star engravings and string glowing brighter until they shine; the glow ebbs as it comes back to the hold.
